import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve();sys.path[:0]=[str(root),str(root/'src'),str(root/'contract')]
from scripts import u2_inputs as ui,vendor_rk as vr
assert ui.ROOT==vr.ROOT==root
assert Path(ui.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root) and Path(vr.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
support=json.loads((ui.ADOPTED/'u2-inputs/support-files.json').read_bytes())
current={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ui.support_files()}
assert current==support and len(support)==56
print('PRIVATE_CURRENT_SUPPORT='+json.dumps({'count':len(support),'ui':ui.__file__,'vendor':vr.__file__,'support_sha256':hashlib.sha256((ui.ADOPTED/'u2-inputs/support-files.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
sys.argv=['vendor-rk','--check'];vr.main()
